catalog.title: Premium Theme Catalog
catalog.subtitle: Explore beautiful web palettes, custom typography, and dynamic animations in real-time.

export.title: Copy To Your Project
export.subtitle: Grab the active theme in any format — pick a file from the tabs, copy it, and paste it straight into your own project.

docs.heroLead: A dependency-free toolkit to pick a preset palette or craft a custom one, then generate ready-to-paste theme code for your framework — CSS variables, button styles, Tailwind config and more.
docs.usePresetDesc: Every preset in this catalog is available from the package and ready to export.
docs.customizeDesc: Pass just a name and two base colors — the kit derives the light/dark shades, applies a default font, and tags the surface variant.
docs.singleDesc: Need just one theme? Import it from its subpath so only that theme ships in your bundle — the rest of the catalog is never pulled in.
docs.generateDesc: returns the files you need with the right filename and project path for each target.
docs.variantsDesc: Each theme renders one of {{count}} preview surfaces; the generated button styles match it.
docs.apiCreate: build a full theme from a minimal custom config
